decisions.decision: Customer booking and appointment management use user-selected sand #EFE4D2 and navy #204464. Sarabun is self-hosted, services form a scannable list, and the navy appointment summary anchors the desktop layout. Mobile retains totals beside the next action. Admin keeps its existing appearance.
decisions.source: User-requested customer redesign, 2026-11-04; 21st search unavailable because the CLI is not signed in.

decisions.decision: Thai-first, mobile-first booking interface with warm paper backgrounds, restrained terracotta accents, readable controls, and a five-step customer flow.
Reuse local Button, Modal, Field patterns, receipt and slot picker across customer/admin screens. Catalog retrieval was unavailable (HTTP 401); no 21st component code was imported.
